title: pouteria campechiana var. nervosa
intro: Pouteria campechiana var. nervosa, commonly known as the nervous sapote, is a variety of the Pouteria campechiana plant, belonging to the family Sapotaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the reduction of inflammation, improvement of cardiovascular health, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Pouteria campechiana var. nervosa include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects, which may help to protect against cell damage and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which may be responsible for its therapeutic properties and potential health benefits.
